3.8.1 Additional Reading
Operating systems and their kernels is a fascinating and extensive topic. This chapter summa-
rized only the essentials. In addition to the sources mentioned in this chapter, the following are
also excellent references, applicable to Linux-based operating systems and others:

   [Goodheart 94] Goodheart, B., and Cox J., The Magic Garden Explained: The Internals of UNIX
   System V Release 4, an Open Systems Design, Prentice Hall, 1994.

   [Vahalia 96] Vahalia, U., UNIX Internals: The New Frontiers, Prentice Hall, 1996.

   [Singh 06] Singh, A., Mac OS X Internals: A Systems Approach, Addison-Wesley, 2006.
